title: Dry Winter Alpha 1.0
author: NinjaBurritoTM
description:
Dry Winter is a nuclear post-apocalyptic exploration/Story game. About 150 years after bombs fell and destroyed the world, you have turn 18 and its time for you to start your legacy. But not all is peaceful in your village.

Dry Winter is in its first version. It is very short at this point. I am posting this to get your input and feed back. My plan is to update this weekly, so don't miss an update. One more thing, the forgiveness rating isn't exact because it is in its early stages, but I have given my approximate answer. Thank you guys so much.
